mapper.sql: l.ListId, l.UserId, l.Name, l.Description, l.IsPublic, l.ItemCount, l.CreatedAt, l.UpdatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT , u.UserId AS Owner_UserId, u.Username AS Owner_Username, u.AvatarUrl AS Owner_AvatarUrl FROM dbo.ReadingList l JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = l.UserId WHERE l.ListId = #{listId} AND (l.IsPublic = 1 OR l.UserId = #{viewerId})
SELECT FROM dbo.ReadingList l WHERE l.UserId = #{userId} ORDER BY l.UpdatedAt DESC, l.ListId DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[User] WHERE Username = #{username} AND Status = 'ACTIVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT FROM dbo.ReadingList l WHERE l.IsPublic = 1 AND l.UserId = (SELECT u.UserId FROM dbo.[User] u WHERE u.Username = #{username} AND u.Status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY l.UpdatedAt DESC, l.ListId DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ReadingList WHERE UserId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT dbo.ReadingList (UserId, Name, Description, IsPublic) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{isPublic})
mapper.delete: DELETE dbo.ReadingList WHERE ListId = #{listId} AND UserId = #{userId}
DELETE dbo.ReadingListItem WHERE ListId = #{listId} AND StoryId = #{storyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.ReadingList SET UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ListId = #{listId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ReadingListItem i JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = i.StoryId WHERE i.ListId = #{listId}
